slides.texte_overlay:
5 things that make you hotter
without changing your face

1. a calm voice

speak a little slower.
it reads as confidence.

2. good posture

shoulders back, chin level.
you look ready for anything.

3. full attention

phone away, eyes up.
nothing is more magnetic.

4. kindness to waiters

people notice. always.

5. curiosity

always have something new
to talk about: a painting,
a city, a strange fact.
slides.texte_sophia:
5. curiosity

i learn something new every
day on a micro-learning app
like the Sophia app.
